body:
PROBLEM. The ADLC phase-router content (the "where am I / which gate" map plus per-phase gate descriptions) is duplicated across five harness plugins in three file conventions:
  - plugins/adlc-claude-code/skills/adlc/SKILL.md   (prose phase list)
  - plugins/adlc-codex/skills/adlc/SKILL.md          (prose phase list)
  - plugins/adlc-pi/skills/adlc/SKILL.md             (prose phase list)
  - plugins/adlc-opencode/skill/adlc.md              (table + prose)
  - plugins/adlc-cursor/rules/adlc.mdc               (Cursor .mdc table)
This replication is a drift hazard: an edit can update some harnesses and miss others. It happened during PR #55 (opencode and cursor were initially omitted from a router edit), and PR #55's whole-branch review (independent agy and opus reviewers) flagged the replication as a LOW maintenance hazard with the recommendation to consolidate to a single source of truth.

GOAL. Define ONE canonical source for the phase-router content and generate each harness's router file from it, so a single edit propagates to all five and a CI check fails if any harness drifts. Preserve each file's required format and front-matter (prose for the three SKILL.md files; a table for the cursor .mdc and opencode adlc.md).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (each with a concrete verification method):
AC1 - A single canonical source file exists (e.g. docs/router/phase-router.yaml or a module under packages/) holding the phase map + per-phase gate text + the adversarial-review discoverability content. Verify: the file exists and is the input the generator reads (grep the generator for its path).
AC2 - A generator/build step emits all five harness router files from the canonical source, preserving each file's format and any YAML/frontmatter. Verify: run the generator on a clean checkout, then `git diff --exit-code` on the five router paths returns 0 (generated output equals committed).
AC3 - A CI-runnable drift check fails when any harness router diverges from the canonical source. Verify: hand-edit one generated router, run the check, assert non-zero exit; regenerate, assert exit 0.
AC4 - The PR #55 discoverability content survives consolidation: every generated router names `adversarial-review` at P1/P3/P5 and contains the exact phrase `exit 0 = SHIP`. Verify: after generation, grep each of the five files for `adversarial-review` and `exit 0 = SHIP`; all five match.
AC5 - No routing regression: each generated router carries the same phase->gate mapping it had pre-consolidation. Verify: compare the semantic phase->gate content of each generated router against its pre-consolidation version (git show HEAD:<path>); differences are limited to formatting/source-derivation, not routing changes.

CONTEXT. Related to PR #55 (ADR-0008 adversarial-review coverage map). The router files were last edited there; use their current committed form as the content baseline to extract into the canonical source. Suppressions are denied.
title: Consolidate the five replicated ADLC phase routers into a single source of truth
